Golden Globes/2011/The Edge.note: The 2011 Golden Globes foreign-language nominee is the 2010 Russian feature Kray, directed by Uchitel, about Ignat and Siberian locomotives. The award record, official producer filmography and distribution credits distinguish it from the 1997 American thriller and unrelated films. The IMDb identifier points to this exact original title/year/director. Provider title aliases retain transliteration and Cyrillic original title.

Golden Globes/2015/Birdman.note: The official Globes short title Birdman is the 2014 Iñárritu feature. Distributor Searchlight explicitly expands it to Birdman or The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance and credits Iñárritu and Michael Keaton. Its IMDb full-title record is tt2562232. Excludes Guy Bolongaro’s unrelated 2015 Birdman.
